title: What Lies Under a Meadow
note: Example film of the Cutaway line (films/lib/cutaway). Playful, kid-clear; the eggs are a storybook, not a geology lesson.

lines.text: Every quiet meadow keeps a secret, and it goes down a very long way.
The top layers are young. A mole digs its tunnel, a lost chest leaks gold, a Roman jar lies on its side.
Go deeper and the years turn into millions, until the stone holds the bones of a giant.
So next time you lie in the grass, say hello to whoever is lying underneath.
